before.title: Cybertruck Accelerator Pedal Pad Detachment (April 2024 Recall)
before.description: Tesla recalled all 3,878 Cybertrucks delivered as of April 2024 (recall 24V-302) for accelerator-pedal pad detachment risk — an unapproved soap during assembly weakened the adhesive holding the pad cap. The pad cap could slip and lodge in the interior trim, holding the accelerator open. No injuries reported but the failure mode is serious enough to warrant the recall.
before.solution: Recall remedy: Tesla service center replaces accelerator pedal — free. All affected VINs covered. Verify your VIN status via NHTSA recall lookup (24V-302). Owners noticed loose pedal pads via simple feel test.
